label: V4.7.8 PERSONAL MAILBOX + PINNED FLIGHT
notes: Workers: one RTDB mailbox query for the signed-in account and selected opDate; no full-day roster reads from the core opener, no second runtime mailbox listener or automatic 3-day form prefetch. Explicit per-flight PIN stores only assignment identifiers/metadata on-device (IndexedDB, localStorage fallback). Reopen checks the exact server assignment before loading that form; existing handover data protections remain. RTDB rules should index roster_mail/$user/items by opDate.
message: V4.7.8 · MY FLIGHT chỉ đọc phân công đúng ngày; ghim chuyến trên máy
